transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Tech support, go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi, my modem's completely down, no internet at all. I work from home so this is a pretty big deal right now. Account number's 883-247-051.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Lights on the modem?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yeah, power light's on but the internet light is just blinking red.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Blinking red, just reboot it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I already tried that twice before calling. It comes back for a bit then goes red again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Try it again anyway.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I really did already try that more than once. Is there something you can check from your end first?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Rebooting's usually the fix, just try it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Alright, fine.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, same thing, red again after about a minute.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Huh.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there anything showing on your end, like an outage in my area?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Nothing showing, so it's probably something on your side.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Nothing's changed on my end though, it was fine yesterday. I've got a meeting in twenty minutes and no way to join it right now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yeah, that happens sometimes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay... is there a next step, like a line test you can run?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can check, hold on.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello? Still there?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yeah, was checking.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, what'd you find?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Nothing unusual, line looks fine.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: But it's clearly not fine, I have zero internet. Can someone come out and actually look at it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's usually only for confirmed outages, and I'm not seeing one.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's confirmed from where I'm sitting, that's about as confirmed as it gets.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I get that, but the system just goes off what it sees.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So the system's word matters more than what I'm actually experiencing right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Pretty much, that's what I've got to work with.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So what am I supposed to do, I have a meeting in fifteen minutes now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could try a different outlet for the modem, might be a power thing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, I'll try that. Can I get your name for my records, in case I need to call back?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's fine, you don't need that.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'd still like it, please.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Chris.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thanks, Chris. Trying a different outlet now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, tried a different outlet, still blinking red.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Well, could just be the modem's old and dying, those things don't last forever.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's under a year old, I got it when I signed up.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Still, hardware fails sometimes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, but if that's it, what's the fix, a replacement? Can you send one?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a separate request, not something I handle on this call.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So who do I talk to for that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You'd call back in and ask for equipment, different queue.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Could you just transfer me now instead of me calling back and explaining this all over again?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not from this line, different system.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That seems like an odd limitation, but okay. What's my account number again, do you even have it pulled up? I gave it at the start.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What was it again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: 883-247-051, same as I said when I called.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Right, got it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Shouldn't you be asking me for a PIN or something to verify who I am? Feels like anyone could call in with just a number.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's fine for a call like this.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. So is there literally nothing else that can be done right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not really. Keep trying the reboot over the next hour, sometimes it just sorts itself out.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's not really something I can work with, I have a job that depends on this.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I hear you, but there's not much more on my end without an outage flag.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can I speak to a supervisor, someone who might have more options?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: They'd tell you the same thing honestly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'd still like to try, if that's alright.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can put in a note, nobody's available right this second though.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, so where does that actually leave me, today?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Keep trying the reboot, try different outlets, if it's still out tomorrow call back and they can look at a replacement.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tomorrow. So I just lose today's work entirely.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's kind of out of my hands at this point.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Alright. Is there a reference number for this call at least, so I'm not starting from zero tomorrow?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No reference number, it'll just be on the account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, I'll trust that. I really don't feel like anything got resolved here, just so that's clear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. Anything else?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, I guess not, I'll keep trying on my end.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright.
